contexts.text: Hypocrisy... infects the interiors of man...
In proportion as evils increase, one infects another, like a contagion...
The good with them is not good, but is infected with evil.
Deceit enters the thoughts and intentions more inwardly, and infects them with poison.
These, being themselves infected (with lasciviousness), had infected others with their contagion...
If the human race had not been so infected, from heredity...
That the wickedness of the Hells should not infect them. Signified.
Lest the leaders... and from them the people of the Church, should be infected with this poison...
